description: This file defines the OX_Upgrade_InstallPlugin_Controller class, which manages plugin installation and upgrade tasks, including generating URLs for plugin installation, handling deprecated plugins, and mapping plugin names to user-friendly labels.

classes.name: OX_Upgrade_InstallPlugin_Controller

methods.name: getTasksUrls
